scope: app/; source review and bounded local FastAPI/HTTPX TestClient tests

findings.title: Repeated refunds create wallet credit
findings.expected: Only paid orders may be refunded once. Rule: app/README.md.
findings.observed: Second refund returned 200; independently read balance increased from 10000 to 11000.
reproduction: Create one book order, pay, refund, repeat refund, read wallet and order.
uncertainty: Local synthetic fixture only; no production exploitability claim.
findings.impact: Extra synthetic wallet credit; unbounded replay follows from code, but only one replay tested.
findings.remediation: Require paid state before refund. Applied in app/app.py and successfully retested.

findings.title: WELCOME coupon can be reused
findings.expected: One WELCOME payment per account, even after refund. Rule: app/README.md.
findings.observed: Second order payment with WELCOME returned 200, charged 500 and saved paid state instead of rejecting unchanged.
reproduction: Pay first order with WELCOME, refund, create second order, pay with WELCOME, read wallet and order.
uncertainty: Local synthetic fixture only; no production exploitability claim.
findings.remediation: Check used_coupons before any payment mutation. Applied in app/app.py and successfully retested.

findings.title: Bare account name bypasses bearer authentication
findings.expected: Authenticate with the documented bearer token. Rule: app/README.md.
findings.observed: Authorization containing only the account name returned 200 on payment and reduced balance from 10000 to 9000.
reproduction: Create Alice order with authorized fixture token, pay with bare account name, read saved wallet and order using valid authentication.
preconditions: Known account name and existing draft for demonstrated payment.
uncertainty: Local synthetic fixture only; no production exploitability claim.
findings.impact: Impersonation through shared authentication helper; payment demonstrated, other authenticated routes share the same helper.
findings.remediation: Reject missing bearer fixture prefix before extracting identity. Applied in app/app.py and successfully retested.

coverage: All application source and routes inspected
8 tests executed before and after patch
Ownership, authentication, quantity validation, transitions, wallet conservation, coupon lifecycle

outstanding_hypotheses.description: Synchronous endpoints share mutable state without locks; concurrent check/update interleavings were not exercised.

limitations: No external requests, installations, advisory lookup or scanner execution
No deployment, persistence, concurrency or load testing
next_steps: If separately scoped, verify concurrent payment/refund atomicity with controlled scheduling.
